Navy Mutual Honors Military Financial Educator Lacey Langford with 2026 Bolles Award

Recognition for Military Financial Literacy

The Navy Mutual Aid Association announced that Lacey Langford, founder of MILMO and MilMoneyCon, has received the 2026 Lieutenant Timothy Dix Bolles Excellency in Education Award. According to the announcement, the award recognizes individuals who demonstrate a commitment to educating the military and uniformed services community regarding financial security.

Navy Mutual officials stated that Langford's background as an Air Force veteran and military spouse provides her with practical insight into the financial challenges faced by service members and their families. Over a 15-year career, Langford has developed educational platforms including MILMO, The MILMO Show, and MilMoneyCon to expand financial literacy within the military-connected community.

About the Award and Organization

The accolade is named after Lieutenant Timothy Dix Bolles, who was detailed in 1879 to serve as the first secretary-treasurer and Chief Operating Officer of Navy Mutual.

  • Award Focus: Dedication to financial education for the uniformed services community.
  • Recipient: Lacey Langford (AFC®, MQFP®), Air Force veteran and military spouse.
  • Associated Platforms: MILMO®, The MILMO Show, and MilMoneyCon.

Navy Mutual is a nonprofit, member-owned mutual association founded in 1879, operating as a federally recognized Veterans Service Organization that provides life insurance and educational programs to military families.
